scope: At most 32 pre-registered source-label groups, one original pair each; engineering diagnosis only, exact two live rows per complete physical table; not up-to-bound or unbounded equivalence, natural bug gold, or evidence all SQL problems are fast.
repeat_policy: Only first query check CPU>=0.25s or query UNKNOWN triggers a second independently created Environment, full schema/C admission, C check, parse, encode and fresh query solver. No warm-formula recheck. Insufficient remaining budget preserves first observation without stability promotion.
stable_timing_policy: Both independent attempts complete with full-C SAT; query verdicts are known SAT/UNSAT and identical; both query check CPU>=0.25s and max/min CPU<=2. UNKNOWN/timeouts, errors, interrupted encodings, missing second attempt or budget overrun are not stable cost evidence.
semantic_promotion_policy: STABLE_COST_CANDIDATE_EXACT2 additionally requires PRESENT_JSON provenance and explicit semantic_admission.complete_original_schema_and_C=true and semantic_admission.original_sql_to_official_ast_reviewed=true. Missing evidence fails closed to COST_SIGNAL_UNCONFIRMED. No status proves business contract truth, a natural bug, or a new scientific mechanism.
contract_missing_policy: Absent constraint field or explicit null: CONTRACT_SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT, no solver attempt, preserve registered slot. Explicit [] may execute no-extra-operational-C only; business completeness remains unverified. Nonempty lists go through complete structural admission; unknown operations/types/arity reject whole input without deletion.
schema_policy: Only types actually encoded by pinned create_database are admitted: INT, BOOL, BOOLEAN, DATE, VARCHAR. Unknown/None types are schema unsupported instead of silently accepted by upstream pass. No field/table/type rewrite.
sat_policy: Raw official SAT only; validate model against all original submitted C/base/type/bound facts and actual query assertions, export full physical raw model. VARCHAR stays encoded because generic literal/collation decoding is unproven. No generic independent concrete-C checker or SQLite replay claimed.
unsupported_policy: Retain source slot and exact failing phase. SQL parse/scope errors and unsupported schema/C are not solver-cost candidates. Encoding resource stop is COST_SIGNAL_ENCODING_UNCONFIRMED, not parser unsupported. Other resource/unknown/not-run observations remain inconclusive.
external_guard_requirement: Supervisor checks unrelated_project/machine gate first, runs one process at a time, enforces 4s CPU/5s hard wall and sampled 256MiB RSS, and terminates active solver interval at cumulative completed+active wall>=1.9s. Total global CPU must include registered scan, imports, failures, supervisor self and children including monitors. Stop before 120s hard total, preserve remaining NOT_RUN slots, no replacement or rerun top-ups.
